jobs.occupation: Terminal worker wanted for Bring in Greve
jobs.description:
We are looking for a reliable and hardworking terminal worker for Bring in Greve for the evening team.

This is a job where the pace can be high at times, so we are looking for someone who enjoys staying busy and can handle pressure when things get hectic.

The job mainly involves loading and unloading trucks, as well as operating an electric pallet truck. It is therefore important that you are used to physical work and preferably have experience operating an electric pallet truck.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has experience operating an electric pallet truck and can work at a fast pace

• 
Is reliable and available Monday to Friday from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM

• 
Enjoys physical work and can maintain a good pace, even when it gets very busy

• 
Has a good attitude and is not afraid to get stuck in

It is important that you are available all five days, as we need someone who can provide a stable presence throughout the week.

You will be employed under a collective agreement, and your total hourly wage will be DKK 190 per hour + evening shift allowance.The position will initially be a temporary position, but if you enjoy the job and prove to be the right person for the role, there is an opportunity for a permanent contract after approximately 3-4 months.

Don’t wait to apply! We review applications on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for interviews continuously. We look forward to hearing from you.

Would you like to develop and maintain advanced electronic and acoustic production test systems as part of a skilled team?

We are looking for a Production Test Design Engineer with hardware experience to join our team in Copenhagen. INVISIO is an innovative, high-tech company with a growing portfolio in the defence and security industry.

The role

As a Production Test Design Engineer, you will help ensure reliable, high-quality end-of-line testing at our production partners. You will also shape the roadmap for our next-generation test systems as our product range and production network expand.

Because we work with production partners worldwide, the role involves periodic international travel.

Key responsibilities:

As part of the Production Test Team, you will:

• Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from defining test specifications in early project stages to implementation and verification at release, followed by ongoing improvements and maintenance.

• Specify and develop the test equipment and software required for PCBA and end-of-line product testing.

• Maintain and support production test setups remotely and on-site at our production partners.

• Help integrate our test systems with a data management platform for change control and test data monitoring.

• Maintain and further develop our Python-based test software.

With a strong hardware background, you will:

• Take ownership of hardware designs within the Production Test Team, serving as the go-to specialist for schematics and layouts for test equipment, from simple adapters to complex audio switching, power control, and programming fixtures.

• Ensure testability is built into R&D hardware designs from the earliest prototype stages.

• Apply insights and designs from early prototype testing to accelerate the development of final test equipment.

About you

The ideal candidate holds a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or an AP degree in Electronics, and preferably has several years of experience developing production test systems.

You have an interest in working with both theoretical and practical tasks, developing a combination of electronics, acoustics, mechanical equipment, and software for state-of-the-art test systems.

You likely bring:

• Experience in electronics design to support product testing.

• Experience implementing product test equipment for manufacturing environment, with the ability to balance theory and practice.

• Familiarity with some of the following:

• Python

• TestStand /Labview

• Altium

• Preferably, experience with acoustic testing.

• Ability to positively influence and build relationships with both internal and external team members.

• A valid driver’s licence and access to a car are required for this role.

We hope to meet an open-minded person that likes to take on a challenge and always strives to deliver high-quality results on time.

What we offer

• A varied, challenging role in an international, growing, and innovative company.

• A workplace with professional and personal growth opportunities, including training to help you achieve your career goals.

• A flexible work schedule from our HQ in Copenhagen.

• A dynamic, supportive company culture with innovation, passion, teamwork, and customer-first as our core values.

Additional information

The position is based on-site at our HQ in Hvidovre, Copenhagen. We do not offer relocation assistance.

This position requires approximately 20–50 travel days per year.

As part of our recruitment process, we are conducting a background check on the selected candidate.

How to apply

Follow the link to submit your CV and your motivational letter, outlining your relevant skills and why you would be the perfect fit for this role before October 25, 2026.

All candidates will receive a response via email.

We believe in equal opportunities for all and encourage all suitable candidates to apply for our open positions.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range: For this position, the expected base pay range is kr55,040.00- kr82,560.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About Ørsted

**

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

• We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Job Overview

**As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will have technical ownership of the mechanical design of laser products and related subsystems. You will work hands-on with the development of robust, opto-mechanical solutions, covering the full lifecycle from early concepts and prototypes to qualification and manufacturing release. The role requires strong technical judgment, practical engineering skills, and the ability to translate requirements into manufacturable designs.

You will be part of the mechanical engineering team in Denmark, working in cross-functional product development projects within a global organization. You will collaborate closely with optical and electronics engineers, suppliers, and manufacturing to ensure technically sound and high-quality solutions.

NKT Photonics offers a supportive working environment with a strong focus on both professional development and work-life balance. We continue to invest in our facilities, tools, and teams to support long-term growth.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Take responsibility for mechanical development of laser products throughout the full product lifecycle.

• Collaborate closely with mechanical engineers, optical, and electronics engineers on concept development, prototyping, and design maturation.

• Own defined work packages within product development projects and contribute to planning, execution, and delivery together with project managers.

• Design precision mechanical and opto-mechanical components including creation of 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings.

• Support prototype assembly, functional testing, and product qualification.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, and continuous product improvement.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to relevant standards.

• Contribute to manufacturing release and production ramp-up.

• Work with purchasing and suppliers to identify cost-effective manufacturing solutions for parts and subassemblies, including sourcing and qualifications of new suppliers.

**Your Skills And Experience

**

• A Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering

• 5+ years of experience with pression mechanics or industrial high-tech equipment.

• Strong 3D CAD skills: SolidWorks experience is preferred

• Experience with opto-mechanical systems, components, or laser products is highly advantageous.

• Ability to take ownership and lead mechanical product development.

• Experience working with design for reliability and manufacturability.

• Strong competence in robust design methodologies.

• Solid knowledge of mechanical design and drawing standards for precision CNC machined and sheet metal parts.

• Hands-on practical skills and knowledge of state-of-the-art manufacturing methods.

• Practical experience with 3D printing and basic mechanical workshop tools.

• Knowledge of materials science.

• Experience with PLM/Vault systems and standard Microsoft tools (Excel, Outlook, etc.)

• Expertise with finite element analysis

• Experience with thermal flow simulations.

• Well-developed analytical abilities: able to question complex information, identify root causes, and deliver strong technical solutions.

• Fluent English written and spoken (English is the official company language).

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Commercial organization.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.

The Role

At Truesec Denmark, we're on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Denmark however the majority of your key accounts will be in Jutland. You will also:

• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Danish team perform even better than today.

• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met.

• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general.

• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling.

• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations.

• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team.

• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.

Your Potential Background

To succeed in this role, we believe that you

• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.

• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.

• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.

• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted client relationships.

• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.

• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.

• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Danish and English.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Flügger is a proud supplier to professional painters and quality-conscious consumers. We are at the forefront of the movement toward a greener construction industry and support professional painters through partnerships, high-quality products, and inspiring design.

We are looking for an AI & MarTech Lead to join our growing Digital Sales team at Flügger!

At Flügger Group A/S, you will join the Digital Sales team, where we thrive in the intersection between strategy, technology and sales. You will play a pivotal role in how AI visibility defines sales strategy.

The way people find and choose paint is changing. Search is moving into AI engines, and agentic commerce is coming fast. Whoever gets found in that new landscape wins the customer long before they reach a shelf or a shop. That makes our product data one of our most valuable commercial assets, and this role is where we turn it into an advantage.

This is a role with real reach. You own the MarTech and CRM landscape, performance marketing and our AI discoverability, and you stay hands-on in the data layer yourself. You’ll build one data foundation that serves both our product feeds and AI: pay once, benefit twice. The work you do shapes what our commercial strategy can realistically aim for over the next few years.

You will report to Head of Digital Sales & Standards and take people responsibility for two specialists within Performance Marketing and CRM.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Leadership and team development

• You lead and develop the MarTech & CRM team, giving both specialists direction, sparring and technical support

• You set the frame for the team’s tools and budget

Data and technical foundation

• You own the technical data and make large volumes of data LLM-ready

• You optimise our product feeds technically and keep the data complete and correct

• You keep our CRM (HubSpot) and integration landscape healthy

• You scale our colour-as-a-product feed from a proven few hundred toward 5000+ by automating SKU, barcode and feed generation rather than doing it manually

AI discoverability and strategy

• You own our AI discoverability and structure our data, so we’re found by AI engines today and ready for agentic commerce tomorrow

• You build one data foundation that powers all channels and AI

• You follow developments within GEO, AI search and agentic commerce, and translate them into concrete initiatives

• You make sure MarTech and performance marketing pull in the same direction as the commercial strategy

Collaboration across the business

• You take part in MarTech, CRM and data forums across Commercial

• You work closely with Platform & Experience, Analytics and Online Products

How we measure success

• Share of products online and correct in product feeds, scaling toward 5.000+ colours

• Performance marketing efficiency measured on ROAS and qualified leads

• Our presence and findability in AI search over time

Who are you?

You are technically strong and comfortable with your hands in the data, while also able to set direction for others. You understand that MarTech only creates value when tools and data genuinely support commercial goals, and you can bridge the commercial and technical sides of the business.

We imagine that you:

• Have solid MarTech and CRM experience and can take ownership of an integration landscape, ideally including HubSpot

• Understand data flows in depth and can make data LLM-ready yourself

• Have experience with product feeds and feed optimisation at scale

• Know the performance marketing discipline well enough to lead and challenge a specialist in it

• Are forward-looking on AI-discoverability, GEO and agentic commerce

• Have leadership experience, or are ready to take that step without letting go of the craft

• Communicate comfortably in English; Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Why join our team?

• Ownership from day one. AI discoverability is a domain we’re building, not one you inherit fully formed. You set the direction, and you have the mandate and budget to act on it.

• Visible impact. Digital Sales sits close to commercial decisions. What you build in the data shows directly in how we’re found, how we sell, and where the strategy goes next.

• Hand-on leadership. You won’t be managed away from the work. This is a role where technical depth is an asset, not something you leave behind when you get a team.

• A team that works across the boundary. We sit between strategy, technology and sales, and we work closely with Platform & Experience, Analytics and Online Products rather than in silo.

• A brand with real substance behind it. Flügger has been making colour for generations, and we’re now bringing that into an AI-driven commercial reality. That’s a rare combination of heritage and greenfield work.

Does this sound like you?

Send your application no later than 26th of October. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait too long to apply.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Head of Digital Sales & Standards, Jens Havreballe on +45 20 87 03 36.

Arbejdsplads: Islevdalvej 151, 2610 Rødovre

Varighed: Permanent contract

Stilling: AI & MarTech Lead

For mere information

Kontakt: Jens Birch Havreballe

I Flügger ser vi udelukkende på kombinationen af personlige og faglige kompetencer og kvalifikationer, når vi vurderer kandidaters egnethed. Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og individets ret til at være sig selv med lige muligheder.

Om Flügger

Flügger Group er en international børsnoteret virksomhed med en omsætning på ca. 2,2 milliarder DKK og ca. 1700 medarbejdere på tværs af grænser. Vi er en familiegrundlagt og -ledet virksomhed, stor nok til at gøre en forskel, men stadig lille nok til at bevare vores entreprenørånd. Vores team består af dedikerede og dygtige mennesker, der virkelig engagerer sig og opbygger en uovertruffen ekspertise indefra.

Working at Flügger

We are an informal, down-to-earth workplace with high ambitions, and we constantly strive to improve ourselves and our business. Our employees are the very core of the company and key to our continued success. When our employees grow, Flügger grows, making continuous development a high priority in Flügger.

Our headquarter is based in Denmark but you will find that we also have positions in Sweden, Norway, Poland, Iceland and China. We pride ourselves on our international outlook and it is important for us to create a culture of diversity, well-being, and good cooperation across departments throughout Flügger. We believe that a diverse team fosters creativity and drives success.

Ready for a colourful career at Flügger?

When you work at Flügger Group, you help bring colour and joy to countless customer projects, whether they are in urban spaces or in private homes. To us, it is not just about paints and painting products; it is about providing our customers with professional advice and the right solution that guarantees a successful outcome.

So, if you are passionate about making a difference and you thrive in a collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: Tax Professional, Customer Handling, Securities Tax Services (Copenhagen)
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Are you customer-focused, structured and motivated by working in an operational area where quality, documentation and service delivery are key? Do you enjoy supporting customers and advisers, coordinating with internal stakeholders and ensuring that processes run efficiently from start to finish?

We are looking for a detail-oriented colleague to join our Customer Handling Team/Tax Services team in Copenhagen. The team serves as a primary point of contact for advisers and customers and plays an important role in onboarding, documentation management, customer support and service delivery related to securities tax services.

On clients’ behalf, Danske Bank applies for a reduction in foreign tax on returns from securities held in customers’ custody accounts. This includes relief of foreign dividend and interest tax, either at source or through tax reclaim processes. The service is complementary to Danske Bank’s custody service and is particularly relevant for clients earning income on foreign financial instruments, where a tax reduction may be available under applicable double taxation agreements.

**About Securities Tax Services

**Securities Tax Services is part of Danske Bank’s tax area and is responsible for handling services related to withholding tax on securities. The area consists of several teams located in Denmark and Lithuania, working closely together across locations, functions and customer segments.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Acting as a first point of contact for customer and adviser inquiries

• Handling customer onboarding and offboarding activities

• Ensuring customer agreements and service documentation are sent, received and registered correctly

• Collecting, reviewing and maintaining required customer documentation

• Supporting changes to customer preferences and service setups

• Coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient service delivery

• Participating in client meetings and supporting customer relationship management

• Maintaining and updating information in internal systems

• Contributing to continuous improvement of customer processes and service quality

**About You

**We are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who enjoys working with customers, documentation and operational processes. You take ownership of tasks, communicate clearly and can manage several activities while maintaining attention to detail.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from customer service, client support, operations, financial services or a similar area

• Have a customer-centric mindset and strong communication skills

• Are comfortable working with documentation, regulations and operational processes

• Can manage multiple tasks while maintaining high accuracy

• Collaborate well with colleagues and stakeholders across teams and locations

• Are proactive, curious and willing to learn in a complex environment

• Have strong English skills, both written and spoken

Experience from Asset Services, post-trade operations, custody services or withholding tax is considered an advantage.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team environment where you can develop your expertise through varied work and mentorship opportunities. We operate a hybrid working model with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing. Your career will progress through exposure to diverse tax challenges and continuous learning opportunities.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would be delighted to hear from you if this opportunity aligns with your career aspirations. Please reach out to our hiring manager Nicolai William Schou Hansen at nicoh@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We look forward to hearing from you!

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Who are we looking for?

**At Lenus, we’re building the future of holistic health. As a Key Account Manager in our Copenhagen office, you’ll target, onboard, and support the leading online health and fitness coaches across the globe to achieve lasting success. If you’re passionate about sales, branding, and strategic growth and thrive on creating impactful relationships, this role might be the perfect fit for you. We’re looking for a natural persuader with a collaborative mindset, and a vision to empower others in their journey to success.

**What you’ll do

**

• Target & Empower Coaches: You will build your portfolio of coaches by scouting, reaching out, pitching, and convincing them to partner with Lenus.

• Building Partnerships: Foster trust-based relationships with coaches that go beyond transactions, making you their go-to collaborator and creates a safe space for difficult conversations to happen.

• Ensuring Quality Excellence: Maintain accurate, timely pipeline and portfolio data in the CRM, including next steps, commercial forecasts, risks, and opportunities. This role rewards strong prioritisation and ownership and may occasionally require flexibility outside standard working hours.

**Who you are

**

• You have a commercial mindset and come from a background in sales, marketing or account management . You are driven by setting ambitious goals and reaching them!

• You’re an exceptional relationship builder who can connect with anyone and foster partnerships based on mutual trust and respect. Adapting to different people and situations comes naturally to you and both are met with positive

• You're a visionary, someone who naturally motivates and influences those around them. You lead with a ‘we can do it’ energy, reframing challenges as opportunities for everyone you work with.

• You embrace the coach mindset and provide candid and constructive feedback delivered with clarity and compassion. When receiving feedback you listen with curiosity, learn from past mistakes and always strive to improve yourself.

• You’re fluent in English and Danish.

Even if you don’t match all of the requirements above, we would love to hear from you! Our most successful colleagues in this role come from vastly different backgrounds, and the key to success is anchored in your personality and mindset more so than in your professional background.

**Your first 90 days

**_Days 1-30: Learn & Connect

_

• You’ll spend the majority of your time being onboarded into our product and commercial processes. By shadowing core workflows you’ll build a solid understanding of the coach lifecycle, team targets, CRM standards, and internal offerings. Lastly, you’ll build relationships with your colleagues and key collaborators and agree on a personal ramp-up plan with your Team Lead.

_Days 31-60: Begin Owning

_

• You’ll take ownership of an initial coach portfolio and prospect pipeline, while beginning to have your first coach meetings with the support of a colleague. You’ll document growth plans and next steps and have signed your first 2 coaches on your own. You’re steadily integrating into the Lenus work culture and begin to foster real connections with the people around you.

_Days 61-90: Operate Independently

_

• By this point, you’re ready to independently manage your portfolio and weekly priorities, while maintaining a qualified pipeline leading you to sign 2 new coaches per month. You have a good grasp of our business model and use data effectively to create growth forecasts and present portfolio overviews. You’re now an integrated part of our community and partake in local events, breakfasts and sports activities together with your colleagues.

**Why this role is right for you

**💰 **Uncapped Earnings:

**At Lenus, hard work pays off. The more you give it your all, the more you grow. Top performers earn big because they deliver big. Your effort, strategy, and results directly shape your success and income.

⚡ **A Steep Learning Curve:

**From day one, you’ll step into a world of learning where you’ll master advanced sales, marketing, and business growth strategies. Within months, you’ll go from talented to top-tier, surrounded by mentors who will push you to your next level.

🌍 **Travel & Global Community:

**Join a network of over 300 colleagues worldwide, visit our international offices, and collaborate across borders. You’ll be part of a culture that’s fast-paced, connected, and full of energy.

🔥 **Creative Freedom & Purpose:

**You’ll work directly with top online health and fitness coaches helping them build thriving businesses that change lives. Every day is different. Every project is meaningful. You’ll lead key clients, design impactful strategies, and never have a dull day.

**About Lenus

**Lenus was founded in Denmark by Bertram Thorslund, in 2016. We are a health technology company that empowers health coaches to scale their businesses through the use of pioneering technology and our in-house business, health and innovation expertise.

We’re inspiring a new generation of health coaches. People who have the power to move not only bodies, but minds too. We are at the forefront of an industry under rapid transformation and our strategic innovations pave the path for the change we want to see. Happier and healthier people.

Today, Lenus is headquartered in Copenhagen, with offices in New York, London, Stockholm, Berlin, Hamburg, Madrid, Helsinki, Oslo, Toronto, Miami, Southern California, Lisbon, Amsterdam, Sydney & beyond.

jobs.description:
Orbis is growing fast. As our biology and chemistry teams grow, we need our data infrastructure to scale as well. We are looking for a Scientific Data Engineer to build systems and structures that capture data accurately and smoothly so that the science team can focus on the science.

About the role

You’ll work closely with biology, chemistry, design and data science teams to understand how they work and what they need from their data, identify areas for improvement and then build solutions using both commercial and custom tools.

This is a chance to join a growing biotech company at a crucial moment as we invest in our lab and data infrastructure, helping build a cutting-edge data platform, designing workflows and building pipelines. This role would suit someone who loves data and code. Someone with a chemistry or biology background with a computational focus, or a software engineer with experience working in a scientific environment.

You will be working onsite in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Develop and manage the Orbis data platform, spanning commercial software and custom solutions, including implementing new systems and migrating existing data

• Work with chemistry, biology and data science teams to gather requirements, prototype solutions, and harmonise data operations across the organisation

• Write and maintain ETL data pipelines to streamline data ingestion and organisation

• Safeguard data integrity and quality in line with FAIR principles

• Collaborate with software engineers and data scientists to enable AI&ML operations

• Act as the go-to contact for lab scientists using our data products and infrastructure

Qualifications & experience

• A degree in chemistry, biology, bioinformatics or a related field

• A strong passion for data in drug discovery

• 3+ years of industry experience in a scientific environment, with hands-on exposure to drug discovery data and how it flows from design through synthesis and testing

• Good working knowledge of Python and common data libraries

• Experience with relational databases and SQL

• Experience designing data structures for scientific data

• Strong communication skills and a track record of working collaboratively with scientists

Nice to have

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP)

• Software engineering practices such as Git, CI/CD, Docker and code testing

• Experience with ELN or LIMS systems (e.g. Dotmatics, CDD Vault, Revvity Signals)

Application

Please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mia Danielsen (part of

DEDENROTH) if you have any questions about the role or the process.

Phone: +45 26178142

Email: mia.danielsen@orbismedicines.com

More about Orbis Medicines

The Orbis’ nGen platform designs macrocycles with oral bioavailability by combining AI technologies with automated synthesis and high-throughput screening of real compounds.

Orbis Medicines has been awarded a 2025 Endpoints 11 title as one of biopharma's most exciting start-ups. This marks the first time a Nordic biotech has received this honor – highlighting the disruptive potential of Orbis Medicines. With a recent EUR 90 million Series A funding round, led by top-tier investors such as NEA, Eli Lilly, Cormorant, the Export and Investment Fund of Denmark and founding investors Novo Holdings and Forbion, Orbis Medicines are well-positioned for significant growth and long-term success. The confidence of these investors validates the potential to bring groundbreaking therapies to the market.

Orbis Medicines has an established R&D site in Copenhagen that includes a state-of-the-art laboratory and a team of +40 experienced professionals and scientists. We offer the excitement of a start-up, opportunities for professional growth, and the opportunity to be at the forefront of biotech innovation. Your ideas and contributions will shape the future of medicine. Please visit the website for more details www.orbismedicines.com.

At a big company, the platform layer is a hundred engineers, and you own a slice of it. A driver. A subsystem. A corner of the release pipeline. You go deep, but you rarely get to hold the whole thing. With us you will. One team owns the entire layer: the operating system and firmware on every Airtame, the streaming stack underneath it, the releases that reach devices in the field, and the work of turning new hardware into a shipping product.

The role is roughly 60% hands-on the hardest problems and 40% growing the engineers who work on them.

**About Airtame

**We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and you'd work from there or remotely from within the EU. We make the hardware and the software that runs on it, so a change you make to the firmware ships to every Airtame in the field. The team is cross-functional and spread across Europe, and it reaches a global market from a small base.

Year one outcomes

Take AirPlay and Miracast from beta to default. They're in beta today. A year from now they should be solid enough to ship on by default across the Airtame product line, so customers get them without opting in and never have to think about which protocol they're using. Judge it by connection success rates on the fleet, and by how many customers rely on them day to day.

Make firmware releases boring. The best release is the one nobody has to think about: a predictable cadence, an automated quality bar, and shipping to the whole fleet as routine. A year from now, cutting a release should be a low-drama process the team trusts, and that should let you ship improvements more often. Judge it by release frequency, and by the confidence behind each one.

Turn the next board into a shipping Airtame. New silicon has to boot, hold a network, manage its heat, and run conferencing well enough to sell. By year-end there's a repeatable path from a board landing on a desk to a build QA can test, and you own it. Judge it by how long that path takes, and whether the thermal and acoustic targets hold.

Lead the team. You'll run the 1:1s, set the technical bar, and support team members' growth. The measure is simple: a year in, the team runs on your leadership day to day.

Push AI-assisted development further. The team already builds with AI daily. You'll lead the next step: sharper workflows, better tooling choices, new patterns that make the whole group faster. By year-end, the team's AI practices should be visibly ahead of where they started.

Who you are

• The player-coach. You've set a team's technical direction: the architecture calls, the reviews where the hard problems get caught. And you want the people side too. Growing engineers, running 1:1s, hiring. You're not looking to trade one for the other. Maybe you've been a staff engineer or tech lead ready to own a team, or a manager who never stopped writing code. Either way, 60/40 sounds about right to you.

• At home where software meets hardware. Embedded Linux is your familiar ground: the kernel, the BSP, userspace, C and C++ running on the device itself. You've spent time close to the metal: wireless stacks, streaming protocols, drivers. You can reason about a bug whether it lives in the firmware, the network, or the silicon.

• You ship to hardware you can't reach. When it's firmware on a device mounted in someone's meeting room, a bad release doesn't just roll back with a hotfix. You've owned software that ships to the field, so staged rollouts, over-the-air updates, and testing on the devices themselves come naturally. "Works on my bench" isn't the finish line for you.

• You've turned new hardware into a product. Bare silicon arrives, and someone has to make it boot, talk to the network, manage its heat, and eventually stream. You've done that kind of bringup, or worked close enough to it to lead the people who do.

• You use AI as a daily tool. You write code with it, debug with it, prototype with it. You've formed your own view on where it speeds things up and where it gets in the way, and you help the people around you do the same.

**Logistics

**Location: Remote in Europe, or hybrid from our Copenhagen office.

Employment type: Full-time preferred. We're also open to a project-based contract scoped to delivering the native protocol implementations.

****Why Airtame:

• A shift worth architecting. Airtame's software is moving onto a widening range of devices, including hardware from partners. Leading Platform now means designing for that spread, a bigger and more open problem than keeping one hardware line running.

• A span you can hold. From the bootloader to the release that reaches the field, the whole layer is one person's to shape here, at a size where you can still keep it in your head.

• A healthy work-life balance.

• Significant responsibility and ownership over projects and your field of expertise.

• Five weeks paid vacation and 5 days of extra paid AirtameFlex days.

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Pension and private health insurance (on FTE Copenhagen contract).

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

****What Our Employment Decisions Are NOT Based On

****Race, colour, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, family or parental status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. And we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment.

jobs.description:
HSO International – Project Manager

Position: Project Manager

Department: Program Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in your country of residence within the EMEA region. Sponsorship and relocation only available within the Netherlands

Type of work: Remote or Hybrid, depending on location

International travel is required depending on program needs. **Minimun 35% travelling

****About The Role

**The Project Manager at HSO is accountable for the successful delivery of a defined project or major workstream within a broader transformation program. This role owns delivery outcomes within clear boundaries: scope, schedule, quality, readiness, and customer adoption for their project.

In this role, your primary focus is on driving execution excellence. You spend most of your time on detailed planning, sequencing, dependency management, readiness control (testing, data, cutover), issue resolution, and day-to-day delivery leadership. You optimize outcomes within given constraints and ensure that delivery reality is visible early.

If you want a role where you own the execution layer of large or complex global programs and make a direct impact on delivery success, this is it.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own day-to-day delivery of assigned projects or complex program workstreams, ensuring scope, plan, dependencies, and customer readiness remain aligned

• Participate in pre-sales and mobilization by shaping delivery plans, budgets, governance models, and risk assumptions that are executable in practice

• Contribute to and co-author Statements of Work (SOW), with specific accountability for assumptions, risks, delivery economics, team structures, phase entry/exit criteria, and change control

• Build and maintain integrated delivery plans that align architecture, build, testing, integrations, and customer activities

• Coordinate cross-functional delivery across architects, developers, functional consultants, testers, integration teams, and customer SMEs

• Monitor requirements gathering and setting acceptance criteria, ensure backlog items are sized, prioritized, and ready for build

• Drive testing readiness, including test planning, data availability, environment coordination, defect management, and go-live preparation

• Maintain strong RAID discipline, proactively identifying risks, issues, dependencies, and downstream impacts

• Identify scope gaps early and initiate structured change-control discussions when required

• Run governance forums that drive real decisions, including steering committees, risk reviews, and change control boards

• Communicate clear, factual status and risk updates to customers, senior project managers, and program leadership

• Partner with customers to strengthen their ability to participate effectively in requirements, testing, data readiness, and decision-making

• Contribute to continuous improvement of HSO’s Standard Working Practices (SWP) and delivery quality culture

• Depending on seniority and complexity of an assigned project, you will work under the guidance and direction of a Senior Project Manager or Program Manager.

**Requirements

**

• 3–5+ year’s experience delivering ERP. Data, or digital transformation projects experience is preferable into ERP Implementation experience

• Must exposure to Dynamics 365 ERP experience or comparable enterprise platforms

• Experience in complex, multi-team or multi-stakeholder environments

• Strong grounding in planning, backlog management, requirements clarification, testing preparation, and RAID (Risks, Actions, Issues, and Decisions)

• Experience working within structured delivery frameworks and governance models

• Ability to see and manage task-level delays and manage their downstream impacts

• Ability to simplify complexity and drive clarity in pressured environments

• Experience using DevOps or similar delivery management tools.

• Hands-on, structured, and proactive approach to execution and problem solving.

• Confidence to escalate issues factually and early

• Influence without authority; create clarity and accountability through facts, options, and trade-offs

• Structured approach to risk management, ambiguity, and scenario-based decision-making

• Awareness of delivery economics and commercial impact

• Ability to balance scope, quality, time, and cost without false certainty

• International travel required depending on program needs. Minimun 35% travelling

**Benefits

****Why should you choose HSO International?

****_Development and growth

_**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and a distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents, and ambitions.

**Career Path for this role

****HSO Offers a Clear, Capability-based Progression For Delivery Professionals

**Project Coordinator / PMO → Project Manager → Senior Project Manager → Program Manager.

Project Managers grow by mastering execution discipline, customer leadership, and cross-team coordination within global transformation programs.

**_Fun and success

_**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**_International project exposure

_**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**_Freedom and responsibility

_**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

Drive business development and secure major EPC projects in the global energy sector.

BWSC – Ever better energy!

Join us in our mission to power the world with reliable, efficient energy, and help shape the future of power generation. 

BWSC is re-establishing our footprint in the EPC market for engine-based power plants, building on a long track record as a turnkey EPC contractor for customers around the world. Working closely with customers and partners, we take projects from concept to commissioning, delivering reliable energy infrastructure where it is needed most. Our expertise in service, operation, and maintenance means we understand every stage of a plant's lifecycle, and that knowledge goes into every project we build.

Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship is what sets us apart.

The position 

As our new EPC Sales Manager, you will drive new businesses by identifying, developing, and winning EPC opportunities in selected markets. Reporting directly to the Director of EPC Sales, you will own the full commercial process, from early lead generation and project development through tendering and negotiation to contract award.

You will be the commercial link between customers, suppliers, and our internal experts, working closely with proposal teams, technical specialists, legal advisors, and senior management to shape winning bids and secure profitable growth.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Developing and maintaining strong relationships with customers, partners, and suppliers.
• Identifying, evaluating, and progressing EPC and O&M opportunities in selected markets.
• Leading bid and proposal activities, including project strategy and commercial positioning.
• Coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, competitive proposals.
• Managing commercial, contractual, and financial aspects in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
• Converting opportunities into awarded projects and ensuring a smooth handover to project execution.
• Contributing to the development and growth of BWSC's Commercial organization
You should expect regular travel activity as part of the role.

What do you bring to the field

We are looking for a commercially driven and internationally minded professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys building relationships while delivering business results.

To succeed in this role, we believe you bring the following qualifications and experience:

• A relevant engineering and financial education at BSc level or higher.
• A proven track record in developing, bidding, and securing EPC projects.
• Strong commercial understanding combined with technical insight into complex projects.
• Experience working with customers and stakeholders in international markets.
• Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities and convert them into successful business outcomes.
• Excellent analytical and strategic skills with the ability to transform opportunities into profitable business.
• Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working successfully across cultures and in cross-functional teams.
• A proactive and result-oriented mindset with a strong commercial drive.
• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken
What do we offer?

At BWSC, you will play a central role in securing and delivering power projects that make a real difference to communities and industries around the world. You will take ownership of major EPC projects from the earliest stage to contract award, with the trust and mandate to shape how deals come together.

You will join an experienced, international team where knowledge is shared openly and collaboration across disciplines is part of everyday work. You will work closely with senior management and specialists in engineering, proposals, and legal, giving you broad exposure and a direct influence on our commercial direction.

In addition, we offer:

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.
• Exposure to large international energy projects and customers.
• Collaboration with highly skilled colleagues across multiple disciplines.
• An ambitious and supportive work culture focused on delivering value to customers.
• A comprehensive benefits package including canteen facilities, fitness facilities, and an active Staff Club.
We look forward to hearing from you

You apply by following below link.

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible and no later than October 30th, 2026.

We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Director of EPC Sales, Lars Munk Lundin at lglu@bwsc.dk.

BWSC wants to promote equality and diversity. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply - regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or age. We therefore recommend not stating age etc. on application documents.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.bwsc.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy and what we want to achieve at BWSC.

BWSC no longer receive, or handle applications received via email due to the directives of the GDPR. For your application to be processed, you must submit your application via our online recruitment system.

About BWSC

Burmeister & Wain Scandinavian Contractor A/S (BWSC) is an engineering and energy solutions company with headquarters in Allerød, Denmark. For more than four decades, we have delivered power generation and energy infrastructure projects around the world, building a strong reputation as a trusted partner within engineering, construction, operation and maintenance of energy assets.

Today, BWSC supports customers across Europe, Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean with solutions spanning power plant services, long-term operation and maintenance, plant upgrades, performance optimization, technical consultancy, and energy transition projects. At BWSC, we combine Danish engineering expertise with a strong international platform and a commitment to delivering reliable, efficient, and commercially attractive energy solutions.

As part of our strategic development, BWSC is strengthening its position within conventional and distributed power generation while continuing to pursue opportunities within the energy transition. This creates exciting opportunities for talented professionals who want to help shape the future growth of an international energy company with deep technical expertise and strong customer relationships.

Our people are at the core of everything we do and key to building strong relationships with our customers. We invest in our people and their wellbeing, supporting professional development and creating an environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal growth drive our continued success and growth as a company.
